title: introduce invocation-flow-summarizer and callsite-level metrics
author: Priya Nair
description:
Context: We currently emit per-invocation spans and high-level per-route metrics but lack a compact summary of the invocation execution path and the originating callsite (client code path) that initiated each invocation. That gap makes it hard to answer operational questions like: which client callsites are responsible for the 95th-percentile latency, where in the invocation pipeline time is spent across different customers, and which callsites have the largest cumulative cost impact over a day.

Proposal: Add an Invocation Flow Summarizer that runs in the telemetry pipeline and emits compact per-invocation summaries and aggregated callsite-level rollups. The summarizer extracts a canonical callsite fingerprint (file:line-ish + function signature when available), aggregates stage durations (parse, encode, model_forward, decode, network), and emits both per-invocation sparklines (for quick UI rendering) and daily callsite rollups for billing/alerting. This PR implements the summarizer, integrates its output into a new dashboard, and adds alert tuning knobs to suppress noisy callsites.

What changed (high level): - telemetry/ingest: add callsite_fingerprint extraction and stage buckets - telemetry/processor: new invocation_flow_summarizer component with lightweight serialization - metrics: new metric series invocation.flow.duration_by_stage and callsite.cumulative_cost_seconds - dashboards: new Invocation Flow Summary dashboard with per-callsite sparklines and a callsite breakdown panel - alerts: introduce callsite_noise_threshold and a new SLO rule that can auto-suppress noisy low-volume callsites - docs: observability/callsite-metrics.md with query recipes and runbook notes

Checklist: [x] end-to-end ingest->dashboard flow tested locally and in staging [x] unit tests for summarizer component [x] integration test that verifies sparkline compactness and retention [x] documented queries and dashboard panels [x] linear tickets linked

Commits: ["feat(telemetry): extract callsite_fingerprint and stage markers", "feat(processor): invocation_flow_summarizer + compact sparkline encoder", "feat(metrics): add invocation.flow.duration_by_stage and callsite.cumulative_cost_seconds", "ui(dashboards): add invocation flow summary dashboard and callsite panels", "chore(tests): add integration test for summarizer pipeline", "docs: add callsite metrics runbook"]

Files changed (high level): ["telemetry/ingest/callsite_extractor.go", "telemetry/processor/invocation_flow_summarizer.go", "metrics/series_registry.yaml", "observability/dashboards/invocation_flow_summary.json", "dashboard/panels/sparkline_compact.tsx", "docs/observability/callsite-metrics.md"]

Testing and validation: - Unit test coverage for summarizer: 12 new tests covering extraction heuristics and stage bucketing. - Integration test: a synthetic workload generator (tests/integration/invocation_flow_test.go) validates that the summarizer output is <= 1KB per invocation and correctly reconstructs stage durations into sparklines. - Staging rollout: enabled behind a feature flag for 10% of traffic in staging; verified that storage increase is ~2.4% and query latency impact is negligible.

Observability and cost: The summarizer emits compact binary sparklines and a small set of rollup counters; raw per-token traces are unchanged. Estimated steady-state storage increase for hosted telemetry is ~0.9% at current traffic with default sampling. We added a config knob (callsite_noise_threshold) to suppress low-volume callsites from rollups to control cardinality.

Review notes & known limitations: - Callsite fingerprint heuristics prefer client-side file/line when present; for SDKs that do not populate callsite info, we fall back to request-origin annotations. This means callsite attribution may be incomplete for older SDK versions — documented in runbook. - The sparkline encoder is lossy by design (8-value buckets) to keep storage small. This is intentional and acceptable for triage dashboards but not for deep forensic reconstruction. - Possible follow-up: expose per-tenant callsite retention policies and add a UI control to toggle cumulative-cost vs rate-normalized views.

Related work: ENG-10190 (invocation sampling rework), PR #162998 (compact-span-encoder), ENG-10301 (dashboard UX improvements).

review_comments: Ethan Walker (2026-02-16): Nice approach. Two asks: (1) please add a short TTL for per-invocation sparklines in the registry so downstream storage teams can control retention, (2) add a knob to disable sparkline emission per-tenant.
Priya Nair (2026-02-16): Added TTL flag and per-tenant enable in processor config; added tests to cover disable path.
Lina Rodriguez (2026-02-17): Found one NPE when callsite info is missing in legacy SDK traffic. Please add defensive null handling and a unit test.
Priya Nair (2026-02-17): Fixed NPE and added unit test. Also updated docs to note SDK versions that do not populate callsite info.
Samir Gupta (2026-02-19): CI flaky: one integration run failed with timeout on the synthetic generator. Reran, all green; approves.
Ethan Walker (2026-02-20): Approving after documentation updates. Leaving a small follow-up for UX polish.
release_notes: Add Invocation Flow Summarizer: compact per-invocation sparklines, callsite-level rollups, new invocation.flow.duration_by_stage metric, new Invocation Flow Summary dashboard. Config knobs: callsite_noise_threshold, sparkline_ttl_days, per_tenant_sparkline_enable.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature flag 'invocation_flow_summarizer' in staging for 10% traffic first, monitor metrics invocations_flow_processor_errors, callsite.rollup_cardinality, and storage_delta_bytes. If callsite.rollup_cardinality spikes, increase callsite_noise_threshold or disable per-tenant sparklines for affected tenants.
migration_notes: Added a lightweight migration to metrics/series_registry.yaml and a SQL migration that creates the callsite_rollup table. Rolling back requires dropping callsite_rollup and reverting registry entries.
backout_plan: Revert the feature flag gate in processor config and roll out a config that disables sparkline/rollup emission. If storage issues persist, revert the code merge via a hotfix branch.
